description: Parse a Nigerian NIPOST postcode in any case or spacing into its 11-character compact form, or NULL if malformed
comment: Returns VARCHAR. Rejects the old six-digit code.

description: Parse a postcode cut off after any segment into its compact prefix, or NULL
Format a code or prefix in the hyphenated style, or NULL if malformed
Cut a code after a segment: state, lga, district, area or unit
comment: Returns VARCHAR. NULL for an unknown segment.

description: Return the next coarser prefix of a code or prefix
Whether a code lies inside a prefix
Strip spaces and hyphens and uppercase, without validating
example: SELECT ng_postcode_compact(' ek-01 a03 fk 01 '); -- EK01A03FK01
